_review: DRAFT Hindi by Claude (Phase 3), for the team to review before the demo. Simple, everyday Hindi for a small manufacturer; ₹ amounts, units (L, g, cm), numbers and the product name stay as numerals/English, as Meesho does. Field labels that Meesho stores in English (option values like Yes / Navy Blue / Free Size) are not translated; when speaking, Navy Blue is नेवी ब्लू. Any key missing here falls back to en.json. The three-screen redesign keys (flow.*, filled.*, netQty.*, q.*, qty.*, price.*, how.*, compare.*) are draft too. Phase 5 growth-loop keys (gl.*: verdict chips, restock card, what to make instead, SKU Health Coach) are draft too. Phase 6 keys (pi.*: Manage Pricing price position and price-hold; pp.*: Warehouse Cluster Pack Point fee card, cost stack, clusters and lot inbound; gl.perf.product) are draft too. Phase 7: pp.selfShipNow, pp.switch, pp.switch.toast, pp.opening.note, pp.stack.selfShipNow (Pack Point offer for self-shipping makers) and the reworded bot.noType are draft too.
